name: amtr
summary: agentic debugger for Claude Code, Codex CLI and Gemini CLI sessions
synopsis: [--session FILE | ID] [--project PATH] [--budget N] [--theme NAME] [--engine PATH] [--python PATH] [--tour | --no-tour] [--engine-args ARGS ...]
description:
amtr attaches to a running or finished agent session and lets you debug it the way you would a process: the model's context window as a live memory map, what fills it and the actual text, a scrub back to any turn, the price of every call, each subagent's own window, and an autopsy of every compaction. Pressing R compiles a ground-truth PDF report of the whole session.

amtr is the terminal user interface; the numbers come from amtr_engine.py, a standard-library Python program that amtr spawns as a child. The engine is found next to the binary, in ../lib/amtr, or through AMTR_ENGINE. It can also be run on its own for a report on standard output (amtr_engine.py --report) or a headless session roster (--fleet).

With no session given, amtr attaches to the newest session on the machine.

options.desc: Attach to a session: a Claude Code, Codex CLI or Gemini CLI transcript path, or its session id.
Attach to the newest session under this project path.
Pin the context budget, in tokens; passed to the engine.
Python interpreter used to run the engine.
Everything after this flag goes to the engine's argv verbatim.
Run a deterministic demo session with no engine: the reproducible scene source for visual and animation validation.
Open the welcome tour at launch. It opens by itself on the very first launch, and w reopens it any time.

environment.name: AMTR_ENGINE
environment.desc: Path of amtr_engine.py; the Homebrew wrapper sets it.

environment.name: AMTR_NO_TOUR
environment.desc: Set to 1 to suppress the welcome tour (scripted runs, recordings).

environment.name: AMTR_NO_FIT
environment.desc: Engine: disable the per-category chars-per-token fit and size every category with the single global constant.

environment.name: AMTR_SELF_SESSION
environment.desc: Engine: the session id to treat as amtr's own, so it is not listed as a target.

environment.name: AMTR_PROXY_BODIES
environment.desc: Engine, with --proxy: also record request bodies.

files.desc: Claude Code transcripts, the primary input.
Marker that the first-launch tour has been shown.
